messages:
morgan: heads up — master pipeline went red right after the merge from @satyam. Failing stage is integration-smoke-3 (gpu-runner). Anyone nearby to grab first-responder?
ci-bot: build #8675309 failed on step integration-smoke-3 (exit code 137). logs: http://ci.internal/8675309
ci-bot: tests failed: 1) tests.integration.test_embedding_pipeline::test_batch_alloc 2) flake detected in tests.runtime.test_streaming::test_stream_close
satyam: ack, I'm on it. I merged a small allocator tweak but it was pretty isolated — will dig in. commit: 9f3b2c1
juan: could be the same allocator edge we've seen. @alex did you bump the shard placement last night?
alex: I adjusted shard smoothing in last deploy but only in dedicated pools. unlikely, but possible interaction with continuous-batching. grabbing logs now.
morgan: paste from failing worker: ```2026-04-02T21:12:34Z worker[pid=4231]: ERROR kvalloc: failed to reserve shard 23, requested 1.6GB, available 1.2GB
2026-04-02T21:12:34Z worker[pid=4231]: INFO serve: model-worker exited with code 137 (OOM?)
2026-04-02T21:12:34Z runner: test failure: AssertionError: batch sizes mismatched```
sre-oncall: I'm up — will repro locally against the same commit and try a rerun. If it's OOM-like we should check autoscaler/burst capacity and any node-level cgroup changes.
juan: can someone trigger a rerun of the failing job first (no bisect yet) — want to see if it's deterministic. @ci-bot /rerun integration-smoke-3 8675309
ci-bot: rerun scheduled: build #8675310 queued by morgan.
alex: quick note — if rerun still fails, run with env var KVALLOC_DEBUG=1 and set SMALL_BATCH=1 to reduce memory footprint; collect `pmap` and `dmesg | tail` from the worker container.
satyam: thanks. if it's my change I'll roll back, but prefer to confirm. I can hold a revert PR ready if rerun reproduces.
morgan: re-run result: build #8675310 -> integration-smoke-3 failed again, same exit code 137. logs: http://ci.internal/8675310
sre-oncall: grabbing worker logs from node-az3-12; looking at docker events... dmesg shows out-of-memory killer invoked around the time of the run. cgroup memory limit was 12GB, process tried to allocate ~1.6GB but several other processes were already at ~11GB.
juan: that smells like noise from concurrent jobs. Did any recent change alter memory headroom or bump sidecar sizes?
alex: I deployed a sidecar bump yesterday that increases prefetch buffer by ~300MB per worker. That could push certain nodes over the edge under high concurrency. It landed in the infra deploy at 03:10UTC.
satyam: sorry, I didn't realize that sidecar bump was in the same window. I can rollback the bump on dedicated pools quickly. Does that need a hotfix PR or a config flip?
alex: small config flip on the infra feature flag should do it. I'll open it now and target the canary nodes first.
morgan: for fast mitigation — can we: 1) reduce concurrency on integration-smoke-3, 2) lower sidecar buffer via feature flag, 3) rerun remaining jobs. Who can flip the flag?
sre-oncall: I can throttle concurrency on the smoke pipeline; flipping feature flag requires infra approval but alex already offered to open the patch. I will throttle to 2 concurrent jobs + queue drain.
ci-bot: throttling applied: integration-smoke-3 concurrency -> 2
alex: opened PR #4282 to lower sidecar buffer config and target canaries. rolling to canary now.
satyam: after canary, do we want a full rollback of the bump or only reduce the buffer?
juan: typo in handle (should be 'juan')
juan: prefer reduce buffer to previous stable value first, see if that holds under load. rollback if canary still flakes.
morgan: thanks all. Assigning follow-ups: @sre-oncall will watch the throttle and rerun queue (action: monitor for 30 min). @alex will monitor canary PR and promote or rollback. @satyam will prepare revert if needed. If anyone hits a repeat failure after buffers are reduced, call for bisect.
sre-oncall: rerun batch queued: builds #8675311-8675314 (staggered). I'll post results.
ci-bot: build #8675311 finished -> integration-smoke-3 SUCCESS
ci-bot: build #8675312 finished -> integration-smoke-3 SUCCESS
ci-bot: build #8675313 finished -> integration-smoke-3 SUCCESS
ci-bot: build #8675314 finished -> integration-smoke-3 FAILURE (exit code 137) logs: http://ci.internal/8675314
morgan: ok one failure remains. @sre-oncall can you capture worker pmap/dmesg for that run and attach? also capture the git commit used (should be 9f3b2c1).
sre-oncall: attached logs to the CI build and to the issue. dmesg again shows oom-killer for pid 5123 (python worker). pmap indicates memory spike to ~14GB before kill.
alex: the canary flip reduced buffer by 200MB, maybe still not enough under this specific packing. I'll revert the bump entirely on canary and re-run the last job. opening PR to revert.
satyam: appreciate it. If revert stabilizes, we can do a controlled rollout and then add monitoring alert for sidecar memory usage.
morgan: update: revert applied to canary. queued build #8675315 for the failed commit.
ci-bot: build #8675315 finished -> integration-smoke-3 SUCCESS
morgan: looks clear for now. We'll keep throttle for 30 minutes, follow up in #eng-infra postmortem if anything else pops. Thanks for jumping in fast. :clap:
